messages:
Leah (support): Hey eng-runtime — Shoreline reported a p99 spike (~3.2s -> 6.8s) on their dedicated pool in us-west around 2026-03-15 22:40 UTC. They also saw throughput drop ~30%. Traces/ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/SH-982. Can someone triage? cc @Mike

Mike (mike.eng): Looking. Do we have request ids or a small sample workload? Any model or quantization rollouts today?

Leah (support): Sent a minimal payload and a couple of request ids into the ticket (trace:abc123, trace:def456). Model pinned: redwood/gpt-medium-8bit@v2. Customer says no code/prompts changed on their side.

Rafael (rsel): Noting deploy-bot posted a kernel-selector rollout to us-west at ~22:33 UTC (deploy hash a1b2c3). Might be correlated.

Anya (eng-ml): I pulled pool metrics: KV cache hit ratio for that workload dropped from ~0.82 -> 0.45 during the window. That could explain both higher p99 and lower throughput if more tokens are re-computing.

Leah (support): Customer says they did increase client batch size earlier in the day (2->8) — but they didn't change prompts.

Mike (mike.eng): Batch size change alone shouldn't cause a big hit like this for our serving config. Let's reproduce on a test slot with the same model + batch settings. @Rafael can you provision a bench slot?

Rafael (rsel): Granted test slot rpool-test-7. Run this: ./tools/bench --model redwood/gpt-medium-8bit@v2 --batch 8 --seq 512 --clients 20 --duration 300 --target-pool rpool-test-7

Mike (mike.eng): Also fetch KV stats while running: curl -s 'http://internal-metrics/us-west/pool/rpool-test-7/stats' | jq '.kvcache'

(deploy-bot): kernel-selector v3.4 deployed to us-west on host group 'inference-pool-usw' (hash a1b2c3)

Anya (eng-ml): If the kernel selector picked a slower kernelset for this model/seq mix, we'd see exactly this. Check kernel selection metrics for that model id and seq dist.

Mike (mike.eng): I ran the bench as above. When the selector forced the non-optimized kernelset p99 jumped to ~6.5s, KV hits fell and CPU usage on host increased. After forcing the previous kernelset manually, p99 dropped to ~2.1s. I'll open a revert PR.

Mike (mike.eng): Repro commands I used:
```
# start bench
./tools/bench --model redwood/gpt-medium-8bit@v2 --batch 8 --seq 512 --clients 20 --duration 180 --target-pool rpool-test-7
# inspect kernel selection
curl -s 'http://internal-metrics/us-west/kerselector/decision?model=gpt-medium-8bit&seq=512' | jq
```

Leah (support): Thanks — I'll ping the customer to let them know we identified a likely cause and are rolling back. ETA?

Rafael (rsel): Rolling back kernel map to v3.3 now. Started rollback at ~22:58 UTC. infra will post once complete.

(deploy-bot): rollback kernel-selector to v3.3 completed on inference-pool-usw at 22:59:12Z

Mike (mike.eng): After rollback p99 for the same bench returned to ~2.0s and throughput normalized. I'll attach traces and open a short RCA + a test that would catch this mismatch.

Anya (eng-ml): Action items: 1) add regression profile to kerselector CI that runs a representative seq distribution and validates kernelset perf, 2) add a KV-cache sanity check alert when hit ratio dips >20% relative to baseline. I'll file issues.

Leah (support): Customer verified improved numbers and is happy for now. I'll keep the ticket open until the PRs land. Thanks team :tada:
